claim: nursery_crm.py report --period 90d printed a table of zeros and asserted them as fact; Plausible v1 rejects 90d. Fourth defect of its kind after DEC-250, DEC-253 and DEC-255.

body.decision: DEC-282 (2026-08-13), found in passing by DEC-281
body.what: nursery_crm.py report --period 90d printed a table of zeros for all 27 nurseries and asserted '0 outbound clicks sent in the last 90d'.
body.cause: Plausible v1 accepts only day/7d/30d/month/6mo/12mo and 400s on 90d. api_get turns any HTTP error into None, and outbound_clicks read None as 'no more pages', returning {}. The stderr warning vanishes when piped.
body.fixed: Period validated against the accepted set up front; a None from any page raises PlausibleUnavailable and cmd_report exits 2. A genuine empty result still returns {} and a missing config still degrades to blank columns. 3 regression tests.
body.family: Fourth of its kind after DEC-250, DEC-253 and DEC-255.
